title: Three products trade the same river
description: 48 weeks of usage share · band width = weekly active accounts · the river swells where the total grows

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered surface labels, semantic tone roles and nonnegative weekly account readings. Each surface provides one value per caller week. A missing measure makes that whole weekly stack unavailable; zero is a measured contribution.

props.name: weeks
props.description: Ordered week labels; repeated labels remain separate categories. Every eighth week retains its original label and floor tick.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
